<title level="1" right="Class Feature 7">[Disciplined Mind](/Classes.aspx?ID=69)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Dark Archives (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=293) pg. 31

**Class** Thaumaturge
</column>

---

You've steeled your mind with resolve. Your proficiency rank for Will saves increases to master. When you roll a success on a Will save, you get a critical success instead.
